description: Header file defining the NinjaCBinaryTargetWriter class for generating ninja build files for C/C++ binary targets, including methods for writing compiler flags, module dependencies, precompiled headers, source files, and build dependencies.

classes.name: NinjaCBinaryTargetWriter
classes.description: Class responsible for writing ninja build files for C/C++ binary targets, with methods for handling compiler flags, module dependencies, precompiled headers, source files, and build dependencies.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the process of writing the ninja build file for the target.

methods.name: WriteCompilerVars
methods.description: Writes all compiler flags including includes, defines, and cflags.

methods.name: WriteModuleDepsSubstitution
methods.description: Writes module dependencies or no-self module dependencies for clang modulemaps.

methods.name: WriteModuleNameSubstitution
methods.description: Writes the module name substitution for clang modulemaps.

methods.name: WritePCHCommands
methods.description: Writes build lines for precompiled headers, updating object and other files.

methods.name: WritePCHCommand
methods.description: Writes a precompiled header compile build line for a specific language.

methods.name: WriteGCCPCHCommand
methods.description: Writes a GCC-specific precompiled header command.

methods.name: WriteWindowsPCHCommand
methods.description: Writes a Windows-specific precompiled header command.

methods.name: WriteSources
methods.description: Processes source files, including PCH dependencies, input dependencies, and module info.

methods.name: WriteSwiftSources
methods.description: Handles Swift source files and their dependencies.

methods.name: WriteSourceSetStamp
methods.description: Writes a stamp line for source sets that are not linked.

methods.name: WriteOutputSubstitutions
methods.description: Writes output path substitutions for the ninja file.

methods.name: WriteLibsList
methods.description: Writes a list of library files for linking.

methods.name: WriteOrderOnlyDependencies
methods.description: Writes dependencies that must be built before others, excluding linkable dependencies.

methods.name: CheckForDuplicateObjectFiles
methods.description: Checks for duplicate object files in a list and throws an error if found.
